We argue that the state-of-the-art (SOTA) feature-based OOD detection methods, such as Maha and KNN, are suboptimal since they only estimate in-distribution density p_{\textit{in}}(\boldsymbol{x}).
To address this issue, we propose FLATS, a principled solution for OOD detection based on likelihood ratio.
We argue that the state-of-the-art (SOTA) feature-based OOD detection methods, such as Maha and KNN, are suboptimal since they only estimate in-distribution density p_{\textit{in}}(\boldsymbol{x}).
